title: Application waiting for review with independent runtime and availability lanes

input.summary: A zero-scope service passed its declared source checks and an exact Application V3 revision was submitted. Maintainer review is pending; nothing is deployed, provider-integrated, or publicly available.

user.outcome: The exact synthetic application revision is recorded as applied and waiting for maintainer review. It is not accepted, deployed, provider-supported, or publicly available.
user.status: Design is ready and declared source checks are structurally complete. Application review is pending; runtime and availability remain at their initial states.
user.nextAction: Monitor the application receipt without changing source or claiming acceptance; respond only if the maintainer requests evidence or records a decision.

facts.statement: The exact project graph contains no programmable-canonical execution or fee-bearing surface.
The declared deterministic source checks completed for the exact synthetic revision represented by this fixture.
A receipt binds the application revision to an applied state while maintainer review remains pending.

architecture: The status renderer reads independent evidence-bound design, implementation, application, runtime, and availability lanes.
The application receipt may advance only the application lane; it cannot mutate acceptance, runtime, provider, or availability state.
A later source change creates a higher revision and returns that revision to pre-review states without erasing the recorded predecessor.

findings.effect: Treating an application receipt as acceptance would bypass the independent maintainer decision.
findings.repair: Render APPLIED_WAITING_REVIEW until an exact Registry-controlled acceptance binds the same revision.

findings.effect: Even a future acceptance would not prove deployment, runtime matching, provider support, or availability.
findings.repair: Advance each later lane only from its own exact evidence and authority.
